_comment: Price list for the `money` subcommand (and opencode_store.bucket_cost). Units: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. NOT vendored from any pricing page — snapshot it yourself with `opencode api model.list` (the working path in opencode v2) and read cost[].input / cost[].output / cost[].cache.read / cost[].cache.write off each model entry. The pre-v2 instruction `opencode models <provider> --verbose` is DEAD in opencode 2.0.14: the `--verbose` flag no longer exists and a positional provider argument is no longer accepted (verified 2026-09-22). Numbers drift (new model versions, provider repricing); re-run the command and update this file rather than trusting it's still current. Only entries actually returned by that command are listed here — a model with no entry is reported as 'no price', never silently priced at $0.
_quota_multiplier_comment: Optional per-entry field: some opencode-go models are billed against the Go subscription's usage caps ($12/5h, $30/week, $60/month per the old page; that window shape itself is an unresolved divergence from the per-model caps — $15 DeepSeek Flash / $60 GLM-5.3-Flash / $15 GLM-5.3) at a MULTIPLE of their base per-token price shown below. AS OF opencode v2 THE MULTIPLIER IS NO LONGER OBSERVABLE FROM THE SOURCE: it was stated ONLY inside the free-text `name` field of v1's `opencode models --verbose` (e.g. 'GLM-5.3-Flash (2x usage)', 'Hy3 (8x usage)', and v1's reconcile once missed glm's 2x silently — recorded/recomputed $0.2773 vs the Go dashboard's $0.56, exactly base_cost x 2), and in v2 (verified 2026-09-22 via `opencode api model.list`) every `name` comes back clean with no other field carrying it. The multipliers already recorded HERE (glm-5.3-flash 2x, hy3 8x) survive from the v1 snapshot and are NOT re-derivable today; do NOT invent a multiplier for any model added after this date, including the MiMo entries — treat its absence there as UNKNOWN, not as 1. Do not apply this to any deepseek/* entry — that wallet is a real per-token invoice, not a quota, and has no multiplier concept.
_captured: 2026-09-22 via `opencode api model.list` (opencode 2.0.14): the four MiMo entries below added from that snapshot. Pre-existing entries carried over from the 2026-08-29 v1 snapshot and NOT re-verified this pass — note glm-5.3-flash still records 0.075/0.25/0.015 while the 2026-09-22 catalog returned 0.15/0.5/0.03; left as-is deliberately, not reconciled.
_quota_multiplier_comment: Optional per-entry field. Some opencode-go models are billed against the Go subscription's usage caps ($12/5h, $30/week, $60/month) at a MULTIPLE of their base per-token price shown below. `opencode models opencode-go --verbose` states this ONLY inside the free-text `name` field (e.g. 'GLM-5.3-Flash (2x usage)', 'Hy3 (8x usage)') — there is no structured field to parse it from. You must read the name field by eye and transcribe the multiplier here BY HAND every time this file is refreshed, or any quota forecast for that model is silently understated by exactly the missed factor (this happened once: glm-5.3-flash reconciled as recorded/recomputed cost $0.2773 vs recorded, ratio 1.000 — but the Go dashboard's quota figure was $0.56, exactly base_cost x 2). Absent field = multiplier 1. Do not apply this to any deepseek/* entry — that wallet is a real per-token invoice, not a quota, and has no multiplier concept.
